title: Sharp fixed-resolvent compression bound through total rank loss seven over every field
statement: Over every field, for fixed-resolvent W and compression factors P of size110-by-112 and C of size112-by-110, put p=112-rank(P),q=112-rank(C). If p+q<=7, then dim ker(X maps to PXC on W)<=max(0,p+q-5). For total loss seven, integer factors of ranks109 and108 attain kernel dimension2 and compressed dimension110. The refined nonzero-kernel bound is q+dim(ker(P) intersect E_full)-5. Field extension and descent remove the algebraic-closedness restriction from the earlier critical compression result.
dependencies: AI-RESOLVENT-RANK-SIX-LOCUS-001 complete all-field low-rank locus, common image and rank-seven gap, pinned to63809d8
Stacks Project Lemma33.34.3 tag0B2R, imported projective-intersection theorem; classical full-row-rank-space reduction via the Segre embedding
Elementary rank invariance and kernel base change under field extension; exact integer sharpness support
limitations: Fixed resolvent and total rank loss at most seven only. Rank-eight matrices become eligible beyond this range. The abstract constant-full-row-rank bound is applied over an algebraic closure, not asserted for arbitrary matrix spaces over arbitrary fields. No general Laurent exclusion, independent review, formalization, target construction or exponent improvement.
